title: Accessible Text Colors
slide_intent: Judge text color together with size and weight so visual identity does not obscure the message.
strategic_value: A repeatable set of text/background choices can make T-Mobile digital messages more legible.
demonstration: Six horizontal samples compare Bold and Extra Bold over magenta, black and white backgrounds with a small-text note.
practical_value: Treat the page as a source-specific reference and verify contrast for the actual size and color combination.

content_islands.name: Contrast conditions
content_islands.spec: Keep the stated size conditions and explanatory text at left.

content_islands.name: Color/weight samples
content_islands.spec: Stack six labeled text strips, each comparing Bold and Extra Bold.

content_islands.name: Small-text note
content_islands.spec: Place the black-on-white guidance directly below the strips.

ingredient.name: Text/background pairing
ingredient.application: The guide labels shown pairs as AA at a minimum 18 pt and calls for black on white below 14 pt; test the actual execution.
ingredient.scope: Digital examples in this February 2024 guide; the source’s claims are recorded, not independently certified.
